plan.notes: Transcribed from the official SCC 'Aircraft Dispatcher Certificate' program map, Catalog 2025-26, published July 19, 2025 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/6936/PublishedPdf). Official Total Units: 37 = 4+12+15+6, verified against the map's 4 / 12 / 15 / 6 headers. This is a Certificate of Achievement (no GE pattern; all courses are major core). The map's standalone Summer Term (6 units) is kept as its own term per the validator term-cap rule. In-plan prereqs sequenced (all with grades of C or better unless noted): FLTEC 302, 304, 306, 330 each require FLTEC 320; FLTEC 310 requires FLTEC 302, 304, 306, 330; FLTEC 321 requires FLTEC 302, 304, 306, 330; FLTEC 312 requires FLTEC 302, 304, 306, 310, 320; FLTEC 314 requires FLTEC 302, 304, 306, 310, 330; ATCAD 309 requires FLTEC 302, 304, 306, 310, 314, 320, 330; ATCAD 310 requires ATCAD 309. The map's alternative FAA-credential paths (FAA Private Pilot Certificate, FAA Private Pilot Knowledge exam, higher FAA Pilot Certificate, or 14 CFR 65.57(a) experience/recency for ATCAD 309) are documented in choice notes but the modeled path uses the in-plan course sequence. ATCAD 310: students should have completed the FAA aeronautical knowledge exam for Aircraft Dispatcher before the class begins (map note). Certificates of Achievement require a grade of C or better in each major course (map note). tccns mirrors SCC local course codes (California community colleges do not use TCCNS).
